deployment: Synapse and Django Matrix control plane before the Matrix KMP client; the replacement is not enabled by a migration alone.

http.success: Existing message/data envelope; empty/204, raw resources and existing paginated APIs retain their own shape.
http.retry: Bounded opt-in GET/HEAD. No automatic write replay. auth-1 refresh: single-flight, stable request_id; replay same rotation for 60s only.

matrix.authorization: Current accepted couple membership, no either-direction SingleConnection BLOCKED edge, and a current Django device-session sid; former, blocked, and unrelated users receive concealed 404. Both relationship and session are rechecked after remote work immediately before the response.
matrix.login: Short-lived replayable org.matrix.login.jwt credential; client supplies and verifies its stable device_id, requests no refresh token, and validates the returned MXID/device.
matrix.session: The replayable Matrix login credential lasts 120 seconds by default (maximum 300); Synapse caps the resulting non-refreshable access and total session lifetime at 300 seconds by default (maximum 900). Clients call standard Matrix logout on SriSu logout/account switch. Already-issued access is bounded, not synchronously revocable through Django; the default worst case from bootstrap issuance is 420 seconds.
matrix.transport: After login, sync, encrypted events, keys, receipts, to-device messages and media use standard Synapse APIs; Django stores no Matrix message content or device keys. A dedicated provisioning identity creates locked private v11 rooms, leaves after setup, and exact membership/policy is verified before activation.

authentication.legacy_cutoff: AUTH_ACCEPT_LEGACY_TOKENS must be explicitly disabled after announced rollout; no automatic invalidation during migration.
authentication.otp: Server-managed Twilio Messaging; HMAC protected, 5 min expiry, 5 attempts, 60s resend, 3 sends/phone/10min, database source/global spend reservations.
authentication.profile: Incremental name then upload or explicit skip; completed legacy accounts retained. No automatic couple creation.

couple_profile.visibility: Authenticated viewers receive only sections approved by both current partners for exact content and membership. Either partner can revoke immediately.
couple_profile.conflict: PATCH sections require expected_revision from that viewer projection. Stale section -> 409 section_changed; different sections/author story contributions do not overwrite each other.
couple_profile.media: First-party authenticated guarded URLs; private no-store; uploaded covers under couples/profile_private must not be served by a public bucket/proxy. Moment references retain original audience and expiry.
couple_profile.story_invites: Idempotent owner-only domain records. The backend does not author plaintext or Matrix events and returns no fake message/room identifiers.
couple_profile.rollout: Apply social 0015 and irreversible chat 0006 only after Matrix is configured. Legacy Django chat routes and data do not remain available after cutover. No deployment is implied.

moments.rollout: Apply additive social 0016 and deploy Django before this KMP client. Existing Moment endpoints/records remain supported; legacy detail GET records views, new readers send record_view=false and POST viewed after pixels render.
moments.publication: Owned UUID draft and upload IDs; publish retries must reuse the same draft and exact caption/audience/photo order. Lock the couple then draft; media processing/storage outside transactions. Clock begins at successful publication.
moments.retention: Visibility: 24h, original audience only. Physical media: existing cleanup 30 days after expiry; staging: 7 days. Published replay tombstones hold IDs/audience/hash only until account/couple deletion. No remotely recalling downloaded copies.
moments.media: Authenticated first-party private no-store endpoints, 10 MiB input, 40MP/12000px decoded bound, JPEG/PNG/WebP only, strip metadata and resize to 2560px. No video.
moments.interactions: Partner heart is desired-state PUT. Partner replies use encrypted Matrix text with strict srisu://moments/{id}/couples/{id} external_url, IDs only. Visitor appreciation stays in authorized existing moment-notes APIs; no couple chat access.
moments.errors: 400 validation; 401 expired session; concealed 404 inaccessible; 403 creator/partner-only action; 409 revision/payload conflict; 410 expired eligible reference/draft; 429 retry after throttling.
moments.ordering: Sequence ascending published created_at,id with signed requester/creator/couple-bound cursor. New feed retains Global/Faves ranking and session cursor, returns server_time.
